d: Company Description Meridian | Youth Policy Forum is a mission-driven organization focused on empowering young people to engage with public policy, governance, and civic leadership. The organization provides accessible resources, programs, and platforms that help youth understand complex policy issues and develop informed perspectives. By fostering inclusive dialogue and critical thinking, Meridian supports youth in becoming active contributors to academic, policy, and community discussions. The team collaborates remotely, leveraging digital tools to reach diverse communities and build a global network of youth policy advocates.

Role Description The Director of Academic Affairs (The Policy & Content Architect) is a full-time remote role responsible for designing, curating, and overseeing the organization’s academic and policy content. This role develops structured curricula, educational materials, and learning pathways that translate complex policy topics into accessible resources for youth. Day-to-day tasks include leading research initiatives on key policy areas, coordinating content development with internal and external contributors, and establishing quality and rigor standards for all academic outputs. The Director will collaborate with program, communications, and operations teams to ensure academic content aligns with organizational goals and supports youth engagement across digital platforms. This role also involves mentoring content contributors, facilitating training sessions, gathering feedback from participants, and continuously improving the educational framework to reflect current policy issues and best practices in youth-focused learning.
q: Strong foundation in Education , including curriculum design, instructional strategies, or academic program development.
Demonstrated experience in Research , such as policy analysis, academic inquiry, data interpretation, or evidence-based content creation.
Ability to provide excellent Customer Service to learners and partners, including responsiveness, empathy, and stakeholder communication.
Experience with Training , such as facilitating workshops, leading webinars, or developing learning modules for diverse audiences.
Skilled in Coaching , mentoring, or guiding youth, volunteers, or team members in academic and professional growth.
Advanced written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex policy issues for youth audiences.
Proven capacity to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
Experience in public policy, political science, education, social sciences, or a related field; advanced degree is an asset but not required.
Familiarity with online learning platforms, collaborative tools, and digital content management systems.
Commitment to inclusive, youth-centered, and non-partisan approaches to policy education and engagement.

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Support Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure food and beverage operations run smoothly. Whether setting tables, assisting the kitchen, or cleaning work areas and replenishing supplies, the Guest Service Support Expert provides the support that make transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Support Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Support Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience. Previous experience in a food and beverage environment preferred.

q: 15 years’ experience in Offshore Process Safety

r: Has demonstrated experience in Process Safety. Knowledge of project engineering practices, international codes, standards, procedures, and specifications.
